subject: Re: ClearVoyant pilot — amendment for staggered billing & surge capacity
messages:
From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@clearvoyant.io>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@clearvoyant.io
Date: Tue, 05 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot extension proposal + split billing

Hi Grace / Marissa,

Hope you're both well — ClearVoyant's pilot is slated to end on Jan 12 but we're running into a couple of integration items that mean we won't have reliable throughput data by then. We'd like to propose a short amendment: extend the time-boxed pilot by three weeks (until Feb 2) and move to a staggered billing structure so procurement can approve.

High level ask: we pay 40% of the agreed pilot fee up front, Redwood invoices the remainder (60%) only if we hit the success metric (50k inference tokens / sustained 20 qps for 72 hours). We attached a draft MA plan with the proposed structure for your review.

We can also add a small burst allowance (temporary capacity spike) for the integration window — willing to pay for it if needed. Procurement copied here for invoicing.

Thanks,
Liam
Liam O'Neill
Head of ML Engineering, ClearVoyant
liam.oneill@clearvoyant.io
(415) 555-0137

Attachment: ClearVoyant_MA_plan_v2.xlsx (proposal spreadsheet)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@clearvoyant.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com, procurement@clearvoyant.io
Date: Tue, 05 Jan 2027 11:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot extension proposal + split billing

Thanks Liam — appreciate the context and the draft MA. We're happy to keep the pilot running so you get meaningful throughput numbers. A few clarifying Qs before we lock terms:

1) Usage profile — can you confirm expected peak concurrency during the three-week window and whether traffic will be steady or concentrated to integration tests?
2) Success metric — the 50k tokens / 20 qps for 72 hours is fine, but we typically also ask for a retention window for logs/outputs to do quality checks. Is that acceptable?
3) Billing split — your 40/60 split is workable as a customer ask. On our side, we usually tie the residual payment to either a) success metric or b) a prorated usage threshold; we can draft both options in the amendment.

Initial proposal from Redwood: 15% one-time extension discount off list pilot rates + the staggered billing (40% upfront / 60% contingent). Burst capacity can be added as a billed add-on at our standard surge rate, or we can provide a capped credit bucket if you prefer predictable spend.

I'll attach a short amendment draft (redwood_poc-amendment-draft.docx) with both pricing options and the surge alternatives. If this looks close we can get Finance to sign off and route an invoice to procurement with Net30. 

When would you be free for a 20-minute alignment call? Tomorrow afternoon works for me.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood_poc-amendment-draft.docx (amendment with two pricing options)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 06 Jan 2027 08:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot extension proposal + split billing (internal)

Internal note —

We should be prepared to move faster than 15% on this one. ClearVoyant is strategic (ML infra play) and the procurement timeline is tight; 20% gets them to green for approval in my experience. Conditions I want in the amendment:

- Define success metrics explicitly (tokens, qps, error rate threshold) and include Redwood verification window (we do a 7-day lookback to validate).
- Make the 60% contingent payment payable upon Redwood's verification of metrics (not self-certified).
- Add a surge cap: 200% of observed baseline for 72h, beyond that we bill at surge rates.
- Finance: invoice to procurement@clearvoyant.io with Net30; require PO number before first invoice is issued.

I'll prepare a short approval note and ask Legal to confirm the amendment language for contingent payment. If Finance greenlights 20% discount, we approve.

Marissa
Director, Sales Ops — Redwood Inference

Attachment: approval_note_finance.pdf (internal approval memo)

From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@clearvoyant.io>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, procurement@clearvoyant.io
Date: Thu, 07 Jan 2027 10:09:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot extension proposal + split billing

Grace — thanks for the quick reply and the two-option approach. Procurement is pushing back on the 15% — they'd like 25% as part of the extension given we're committing up front. We're ok with the contingent 60% being subject to Redwood verification, but procurement insists on the invoice structure being 50% upfront / 50% owed on verification. Their reason: internal approvals only allow a 50% initial disbursement for pilots without a signed PO for the full amount.

We can accept the surge cap you suggested if it's included in the amendment (and a capped credit bucket would be preferable to per-hour surge billing). Also — procurement asked for SOC 2 evidence and a short info security checklist before they release any funds. Can your team share that pack?

If you can meet 25% discount and 50/50 invoice split (Net30 on the second payment), we can sign the amendment and issue a PO the same day.

Best,
Liam

Attachment: none

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@clearvoyant.io>, procurement@clearvoyant.io
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 08 Jan 2027 14:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot extension proposal + split billing — final terms

Liam / procurement team — thanks for the transparency. Summary of what Redwood can commit to: 

1) Extension: pilot extended to Feb 2 (three-week addendum).
2) Pricing: 20% one-time extension discount off our pilot list rates (we can move to 20% today; 25% would need Senior RevOps sign-off and would delay the PO).
3) Billing: 50% upfront / 50% contingent on Redwood verification of agreed success metrics. Second payment due Net30 after invoice.
4) Success metrics: 50k inference tokens AND sustained 20 qps for 72 hours with error rate <2% (Redwood to verify via logs; we hold a 7-day validation window).
5) Surge: include a capped credit bucket equal to 25% of pilot token allocation for bursts; any usage beyond that billed at our standard surge rate.
6) Procurement asks: attached SOC2 summary + short security checklist (we'll send full evidence through the secure portal once PO is issued).

If the above aligns, we'll attach the final amendment and Finance will issue an invoice for 50% once we receive a PO. Please confirm and we can turn this around today.

Thanks — looking forward to continuing the work.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com

Attachments sent separately: SOC2_summary.pdf, redwood_poc-amendment-final.docx
